pages.title: Metamaterial Weaver
pages.text: Sketchbook. The $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$() lays down sub-wavelength lattices that bend light (and gravity) the wrong way.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

Day 37. In real metamaterials, structure smaller than a wavelength can give a negative refractive index: light bends to the wrong side of the normal. That is the trick behind laboratory invisibility cloaks. This machine weaves such lattices - and, it seems, for gravity as well.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Dark Matter Lens, Dipole Winding, Dyson Shell Segment, Dyson Swarm Satellite, Gravitic Lens Element, Metamaterial Sheet, Möbius Strip, Photonic Circuit Board, Photonic Processor, Superconducting Coil.
